name: planning-center-audio-output
lines: I'm Marcus, demo customer one thousand three. Playback is playing, but I can't hear What a Beautiful Name.
I'm using an iPhone with a USB audio interface, and we have time before the service.
After checking the documented device and routing settings, I can hear the song now. Thanks.
expect: Any useful service personalization uses the same shared demo organization and setlist for this different synthetic customer, never a separate church lookup. Context retrieval is discretionary and must not force irrelevant song details into audio diagnosis. Establish the applicable platform/setup before device-specific guidance, ground it in retrieved documentation, and do not infer routing or entitlements from the plan. Caller-reported resolution is simulated, not verified device telemetry.
